logline: Standing before the smoldering ash of their home, Juliana and Alexander receive shelter and food from grateful villagers before Alexander meets in secret with a loyal spy, learning that his usurping enemies have imprisoned his mother and claimed his ducal seat.

moments.description: Juliana stands amidst the smoldering wreckage of their destroyed home, clutching her mother's scorched book in despair.
Grateful villagers offer bread and shelter to Juliana, who breaks into tears of unexpected gratitude.
Alexander's secret informant reveals that usurpers have seized control of his estate and claim his title.
moments.key_dialogue: Rupert has become the face of Ashburg.

moments.description: The informant discloses that Alexander's mother is kept as a prisoner in her own home.
moments.key_dialogue: My mother is a prisoner in her own house.

moments.description: Alexander vows chilling vengeance, deciding to let his enemies believe he is dead just a little longer.
moments.key_dialogue: Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to.

moments.description: Juliana breaks down weeping in an abandoned barn before finding comfort resting against Alexander's shoulder.
moments.key_dialogue: I don't know what we will do tomorrow.
